name: a8-oom-weakest-link
notes: A8 (2.4): a chain is only as strong as its weakest link. The limit-to-OOM head edge is MEDIUM and the OOM-to-exit edge HIGH, so the exit anchor's root confidence is MEDIUM. Re-audit note: with the weaker edge at the head this fixture cannot tell weakest-link from the old strongest-leaving-edge bug; TestPrincipalAuditA8bWeakLinkDownstreamOfStrongHead is the discriminating check.

5.2 item 3: OOM_EVENT has an incoming Causal edge from a CONDITION (the limit), so it is not a root candidate - it is the mechanism (5.3). The one root candidate is the episode head MEMORY_LIMIT_REACHED, PRIMARY at the weakest-link band MEDIUM.
The severe unresolved limit keeps its own analysis with root cause UNKNOWN and the known escalation chain (5.1, 5.6 oom-chain row).
Events-mode fixture: the injected rule edges carry truthful check records; events must not be edited to sharpen the bands.

Re-audit 2026-10-28 (principal, causal-semantics.md §5.2 clarified): a failure is never its own candidate, and an escalation-only path is the anchor's own episode (known chain), not a contributing factor. Suspected-kill/write-failure alternatives explain exit failures only, never a condition anchor.
